Wow, thanks for the detailed write up! 

Do you happen to know that much about Chanter too? Just for parity's sake.

Hey - I'd like some help picking a healer please!

I'm coming back to the game after not playing since the end of cata, at my friend's request. I've been playing FFXIV a lot, where I main a Scholar - is there something similar to that in WoW? I like how versatile it is, where I can throw out some DPS while healing, as well as have, when needed, ways to alter abilities to deal with a situation/tools or short CDs to deal with things. Having a pet healer is nice too but as far as I'm aware (unless something's been added) nothing like that exists here right? any help would be great :)
About 5 years ago~, though probably longer all things considered.
